description.value: The Notorious Grey Fox Taps & Patio is a sports bar and pub set inside the historic BC Penitentiary Building in New Westminster. It pours 22 craft beer taps alongside artisan cocktails and a food menu built around creative spins on pub classics. The venue runs a busy calendar of weekly events — trivia, open mic, karaoke, and live sports — making it a lively urban stop on any Fraser Valley cycling route.
